items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 27:1
items.html: At first the inner light certainly prevailed, for the first nine Sefirot clothed there in the reflected light of the screen in actuality, and it even remained so after the departure, since there is no absence in spirituality, as written above. And afterwards the surrounding light prevailed over the inner light, until it refined the screen entirely and equalised its form with the Emanator — that is, with Malchut of the Rosh [head], where surrounding light and inner light are joined together (as above, Item 91) — and there it received force, until the second expansion, which is called Partzuf AB, emerged from it downward (as above, Item 91).
